policy: Frozen pre-rewrite wording debt found by GET-202 foundation batch A against the accepted GET-201 source. Every entry binds one item, locale, rule and the exact value SHA256 that existed at the frozen revision, and stays explicitly unreviewed until individually reviewed. This is NOT a justified exception (see tools/copy-lint-allowances.json). Maintenance is manual: prune an entry only after its wording is reviewed and changed; never re-record new wording here, the frozen-revision binding rejects it. There is deliberately no regeneration command.
